description: This file implements the FifoBuffer class and its derived classes for managing FIFO buffers in Android's audio system, including buffer allocation, reading, writing, and memory management.

classes.name: FifoBuffer
classes.description: Base class for FIFO buffer management, providing core functionalities like conversion between frames and bytes, buffer reading/writing, and memory erasure.

classes.name: FifoBufferAllocated
classes.description: Derived class that allocates internal storage for FIFO buffer based on capacity.

classes.name: FifoBufferIndirect
classes.description: Derived class that uses external storage for FIFO buffer, with indirect control via pointers.

methods.name: convertFramesToBytes
methods.description: Converts frame count to byte count based on bytes per frame.

methods.name: fillWrappingBuffer
methods.description: Fills a wrapping buffer with available data, handling wrap-around at buffer end.

methods.name: getFullDataAvailable
methods.description: Returns the number of full frames available for reading and fills wrapping buffer.

methods.name: getEmptyRoomAvailable
methods.description: Returns the amount of empty space for writing and fills wrapping buffer.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from FIFO buffer into provided buffer, handling wrap-around.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data from provided buffer into FIFO buffer, handling wrap-around.

methods.name: getBufferCapacityInFrames
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the buffer in frames.

methods.name: eraseMemory
methods.description: Clears the buffer memory by zeroing out.
